raw_text: IT EN DE MENU HOME / PROPERTIES / NUOVO APPARTAMENTO TRILOCALE CON TERRAZZO VIVIBILE FOR SALE · APARTMENT Nuovo Appartamento Trilocale con Terrazzo Vivibile JESOLO PAESE · JESOLO · VENEZIA PRICE €335,000 Photos (36) Floor plans (1) 1 / 36 FLOOR AREA 100 m² BEDROOMS 2 BATHROOMS 2 LIFT Yes ENERGY CLASS A4 Overview Welcome to your new home in Jesolo Paese! If you are looking for a practically new, modern, and ready-to-live-in house, this is a proposal that stands out. Located in an elegant residential context of only six units, built in 2025, this refined apartment combines comfort, technology, and quality construction in one of the most sought-after areas of Jesolo Paese. The location is ideal: quiet, private, and away from traffic—just two minutes from the center and all major services while the beach is only two kilometers away. Situated on the second floor and served by an elevator, the property welcomes you with a beautiful living area of about 40 square meters facing south where natural light becomes the protagonist throughout the day. The open kitchen perfectly integrates into the environment and opens onto a spacious livable terrace of approximately 20 square meters—ideal for outdoor lunches or dinners with friends or simply enjoying moments of relaxation. Inside the living area there’s also a convenient veranda used as a laundry room while a first windowed bathroom complete with shower serves this space. The hallway leads to the sleeping area which consists of one master bedroom and one double bedroom both having direct access to another terrace along with a second windowed bathroom equipped with another shower box. This dwelling has been designed to offer maximum living comfort thanks to its A4 energy class rating; it features photovoltaic systems; underfloor heating; air conditioning system; and top-of-the-line finishes ensuring high energy efficiency combined with low management costs. Completing this offering are two comfortable covered parking spaces available separately at an overall price of €25,000 as well as a private cellar also purchasable separately priced at €10,000—a solution providing maximum flexibility allowing buyers to customize their purchase based on personal needs. Another element making this proposal truly exclusive is its furnishing crafted entirely custom-made using high-quality materials & finishes aimed at enhancing each room's elegance & functionality. Furniture can be purchased separately giving potential owners an opportunity to move into meticulously curated homes ready for immediate occupation right from day one. What makes this opportunity even more appealing is its fiscal aspect: despite being very recently constructed (completed in 2025), since it's sold by private sellers buyers benefit from ordinary tax regime without VAT typically applied when purchasing directly from developers—a significant economic advantage translating into considerable savings during acquisition phase itself! A solution tailored specifically towards those unwilling compromise seeking recent efficient contemporary taste dwellings nestled within exclusive serene settings just minutes away beaches alongside essential amenities nearby too! Contact us for further information or schedule viewings today!
